ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Masterpieces of 20th-Century Slavic Literatures: Progress, Technology, and Art. In this course, students will read some of the best works of 20th-century Czech, Polish, Serbian, Croatian, and Ukrainian literatures that address the themes of progress and technology, the human and the mechanical, and the role of art in a progress-driven technological world. Our focus will be on shorter works (poems, stories, and plays) by Stanis?aw Lem, S?awomir Mro?ek, Wis?awa Szymborska, Karel ?apek, V¿clav Havel, Ivo Andri?, Miroslav Krle?a, Valerian Pidmohylny, Oksana Zabuzhko, and others. Readings will be complemented with several films from the region.
